Name: Root Eruption
Description:
R: 24"

AP: -1
Special Rules: Bombardment, Move & Shoot, Multiple Wounds (D3+1)

Notes: This weapon shoots like a stone thrower, using the 'Bombardment' special rule and a 3" blast template (5" for a Gargantuan Treeman Ancient). If a 'Misfire' is rolled on the Artillery dice, this model loses a single Wound (instead of rolling on a Misfire table). The Multiple Wounds (D3+1) special rule applies only to a single model whose base lies underneath the central hole of the blast template.
